finding: Owners so retains/stamps the offset ndarray owner chain, but Input descriptors are created only for seed, mask and footprint. The offset is converted directly to ReconstructionSpan<const size_t>{offset.data(), offset.size()}. Dtype, rank, C-contiguity and alignment are checked; no complete offset byte span is compared with the current pinned root allocation. reconstruction_requirements verifies raw span arithmetic/size, then dereferences f.offset.data[d]. Thus an already stale ndarray offset view can pass unchanged metadata stamps while extending beyond its present root allocation.
minimum_repair: After native contiguous size_t vector validation, validate the complete contiguous offset byte span against the pinned root allocation using overflow-safe address/range arithmetic, before requirements can dereference offsets. Keep the existing owner revalidation after conversions/allocations and immediately before release. Add a safe metadata-only extent rejection regression, with old e17 code never invoked on unsafe storage.
